scope: Compare the retained typed MLINESTYLE in one physical AC1021 source with independent LibreDWG minJSON. This records only the MLINESTYLE frame and does not qualify full-source inventory closure.

implementation.method: The adapter test diagnostic emits retained frame identity/common links and typed MLINESTYLE fields. A source-profile auditor binds the DWG before and after, selects exactly one type-73 frame, requires its typed row and dictionary identity to agree, then compares the scalar/element values and 79-byte object size with LibreDWG minJSON. The source-profile audit permits only the explicitly identified later VISUALSTYLE assertion failure; all earlier source import, capture, frame and MLINESTYLE checks complete.
